headline: The dry shelf, and the merge path mends itself
lede: For the first time this cycle the never-dry ladder came up honestly empty — and the quiet emergency was elsewhere: the rule-5 merge path had bitten both builder slots the same night. #3070 names the root cause, the fix ships with a sandbox that finally tells the truth about gh, and its own merge completed cleanup unattended for the first time in the family's three-bite history.

notes.text: #3070 shipped (#3071): mergeclean now resolves the PR by branch — `gh pr view --repo` refuses a number-less lookup, which is exactly where post-merge cleanup died after #3065 and #3068, leaving lanes parked on local main. The stray-main sweep automates the documented manual finish; forge-merge refuses an on-main lane. mergecheck 33/33 with faithful fake gh + deep-cleanup replay; mutant red x18; dogfooded on its own merge: 'stray main swept', zero manual steps.

Slot a declined the warden's #3067 assignment: slot b held it LIVE (running session, port 5178, push 6 minutes prior) — the claim script only passed it because checkpoints that quote a sha instead of the word 'checkpoint' are invisible to liveness. Root-cause evidence posted on #3053; no hijack.

Shelf genuinely dry at close: idle-kick NONE on builder and QA rungs; no third same-source override attempted this cycle. The new-title ask is cap-held until ~Nov-27 — Jon's Nov-20 answer (DOUBLE DRAGON + R-TYPE) is already landed and polished.
